remarks: A wonderful 4-bedroom Cape Cod Style home in the Newfield section of Stamford. The open floor plan has a living room with fireplace, that leads to the adjacent dining area and a cozy eat-in-kitchen. The primary bedroom, a full bathroom and second bedroom complete the first floor. Off the dining area there is a walk-out to a sun-filled Trex deck. Upstairs there are two bedrooms and a full bath. Newly refinished hardwood floors and fresh paint on the first and second floors. The lower level has a large finished family room and a laundry/utility room. New furnace and garage door opener. A lovely level back yard. Located on a welcoming tree-lined street in the heart of Stamford, within minutes of parks, golf & tennis, schools, dining and shopping. Enjoy the vibrant downtown Stamford and three amazing public beaches on Long Island Sound. Welcome Home!
